name: feature.users.nodes
description: Users feature node pack (ADR 0617 D2) — the host-account lifecycle over the ctx.features.users surface. deactivate disables THIS workspace's own durable account (ends its live sessions, ADR 0621) and reactivate re-enables one. Both are side-effects gated on the run's acting user holding host:members:manage in the run's tenant — the same predicate the /users admin routes use; a system run (schedule, webhook, host-event-started) fails closed. Ids-only inputs and outputs. The offboarding step people-hr.offboarding's `deprovision-host` composes.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Users: Deactivate Account
nodes.description: Disables one durable account in the run's tenant over ctx.features.users (status → disabled; its live sessions end on their next request). Requires an acting user holding host:members:manage; refuses the acting user's own row (self_lockout). Side-effecting: a replay/fork is served the recorded outcome, never re-executed. Emits host.users.user.deactivated (reason: workflow) on the transition only, stamped with the run's origin (workflow + chain lineage) so a binding to that event cannot re-trigger the executing workflow or a sibling instance of its chain. The target comes from inputs.userId, else the host.users.user.* event payload that started the run (never a manual run's inputs), else the frozen config.userId.

nodes.label: Users: Reactivate Account
nodes.description: Re-enables one disabled durable account in the run's tenant over ctx.features.users (status → active; old sessions stay dead — the user signs in again). Requires an acting user holding host:members:manage. Side-effecting: a replay/fork is served the recorded outcome. Emits host.users.user.reactivated (reason: workflow) on the transition only.
